tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos kyi rje rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug gi rnam thar bsam pa de 'byung gi nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ dharmā swā mi yu ba rā dzaḥsaṅgu ā nanda shwa ra ye na maḥ bod skad du/ chos kyi rje rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba dges pa'i 'dzum zhal las/ /lung bstan bdud rtsi brnyes pa bzang po'i zhabs/ /gang gi rgyal tshab dam pa grags thob der/ /deng nas byang chub bar du spyi bos 'dud/ /de lta'i yongs 'dzin mchog gi rnam thar cha/ /dad cing gus pa'i yid kyis 'dir spel bas/ /bdag la bstan 'dzin chos dang rigs kyi bu/ /myur du 'byung ba'i dngos grub bde blag stsol/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab nas/ 'dir rgyal tshab dam pa'i rnam thar mdo tsam bshad par bya ste/ de yang rje btsun dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug ces grags pa 'di ni/ nges par rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid yin mod kyi/ skye bo phal mo che'i snang ngor mi rnams kyi nang du skye ba'i tshul bzung nas mdzad pa du ma bstan to/ /de la re zhig thun mong gi snang ngo dang mthun pa'i rnam par thar pa brjod na/ gzugs sku'i mdzad pa dang / chos sku'i mdzad pa dang / 'phrin las kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sku rab tu ma byung ba dang / rab tu byung ba'i rnam par thar pa'o/ /dang po la/ 'di'i rigs ni 'bring tsam gyi cog ro zhes bya ba rje rdo rje 'chang dang 'dra ba yin la/ yab mes gong ma rnams 'bring tsam nas sa skya phyogs su byon te/ ga ra la sogs par 'brog mdzad cing bzhugs pa la/ rim gyis gdung brgyud rin po che rnams dang / bla brang shar pa rnams kyi gsol dpon du gyur nas gdung rabs bcu lhag tsam song ba yin no/ /khyad par bdag nyid chen po 'di'i yab ni/ chos rje shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi gsol dpon drung chen bde legs zhes bya ba rnam dpyod gtsang zhing thugs rgyud des la brtse ba chen po dang ldan pa zhig yin la/

drung chen gyi btsun mo dpon ne dge bsnyen ma la sras po med pas rje 'di'i yum ni/ mus kyi mthong pa mkhas btsun dpal ldan bzang mo zhes bya ba yin no/ /de ltar na yang dpon ne dge bsnyen mas shin tu byams shing brtse bar byas pas 'di drin che ba gcig yin gsungs/ chu mo yos kyi lo la lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe/ yum la byang chub sems dpa' rnams lhums su zhugs pa'i ltas dang bcas te gnod pa med la ngang rgyud bzang zhing 'jam pa'i rang bzhin du gyur to/ /shing pho 'brug gi lo ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas nas 'khrungs te/ rje sems dpa' chen po shāka bzang sku 'bum du chos gsan du phebs pa dang lo'i dus cig pa yin gsungs so/ /de nas dgung lo drug bdun bzhes dus dge bsnyen kun dga' grub ces bya bar mtshan gsol te/ skyed lhas dgon par slob dpon dpal ldan don grub pa zhes bya ba'i drung du klog yig la sogs pa thun mong ba'i rig pa rnams mthar phyin par mdzad do/ /de'i dus byis pa chung ngu yin pas/ kha'u'i mgon khang gi nang du dkon gnyer med pa'i skabs su zhugs nas dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa dngos su thim pa'i sa de la sgo chung ngu ma bdag chen rnams kyi phyag dam 'byar ba zhig 'dug pa bshigs nas nang tshun chad bltas/ rdo'i maṇḍal gcig dang nas mang po 'dug gzhan sku la sogs pa ni ci yang mi 'dug bu tsha bsam med du song ba yin nam/ snga nas kyi las 'brel yod pa yin nam/ 'khu ldog la sogs pa'i rnam pa ni ci yang ma byung / gzhan thams cad ni 'jigs por byed kyi gda' gsungs te/ de'i dus nyid nas bka' srung khyad par can rnams rjes su 'brangs par snang ngo / /gnyis pa rab tu byung ba'i rnam thar ni/ bslab pa rin po ches rgyud gtams pa/ thos bsam sgom gsum spel mar mdzad pa/ khyad par gyi yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul gsum las dang po ni/ dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa shing mo yos kyi lo la gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i bla brang shar du rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang pos mkhan po dang /

byang phug pa kun dga' legs pas slob dpon mdzad de rab tu byung nas mtshan yang kun dga' dbang phyug ces btags so/ /de nas chos rje byang phug pas byang phug tu khrid de/ kye rdo rje'i rgyud gsum gyi gzhung rnams la thugs sbyong legs par mdzad/ de dus kyi yig cha ni/ 'phags pa rin po che'i mchan dang / spyi rnam dag chung / ljon chung rnams yin gsungs/ khyad par rtsa ba'i rgyud la zhal 'don brgya phrag du ma zhig mdzad de/ de'i dus kyi bzhugs sa spyil po chung ngu byin rlabs dang bcas pa ngo mtshar ba zhig ding sang yang yod ces grag rgyud 'di rnams bka' shin du gnyan pa yin pas gang thod thod du 'dzin sbyong byed pa'i srol med/ sngon gyi sa skya pa rnams rgyud 'dzin tsa na thun gtor chag med du byed pa yin no/ /ngas kyang byang phug tu rgyud 'dzin tsa na gtor ma chag med du 'bul gyin bzung ba yin gsungs/ de nas dgung lo bco lnga bzhes pa sa pho rta'i lo la dpal e wam̐ chos ldan yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas su phebs nas/ chos kyi rje rin po che'i drung du nye bar mnyan te dam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs ci rigs pa yang gsan cing / gtso che ba ni spyod lam gyi sgo bla ma dam pa mnyes par mdzad pa dang / phyi nang gi las su bya ba mtha' yas pa zhig dka' ba chen pos dang du blangs shing / rje rin po che'i gsol zho'i mdzo mo 'tsho ba la sogs pa yang rgyun ring po'i bar du mdzad do/ /de lta bu'i skabs shig tu chos rje paṇḍi ta rje'i drung na bzhugs tsam na/ bla ma 'di nyid kyis sku sked la 'ur rdo chung ngu gcig dkris te mdzo 'tsho ru phyin tshar nas bla ma'i drung du phyag 'bul la byon byung / khong phyir thegs tsam na/ bla ma'i gsung las/ 'dis ma 'ongs pa na 'o cag gi gdan sa byed rgyu yin gsung gin 'dug 'o na bdag cag gis gdan sa byed lags sam zhes zhus pas/ kha rog sdod khyod kyis mi 'ong gsungs/

khos yong ba yin gsung gin 'dug pas dang po de tsam gyi dus nas bla ma'i thugs kyi dgongs pa yin gsungs nas/ de'i dus birwa'i pa'i rnam 'gyur drug /sa chen yab sras gsum/ chos rje khu dbon gnyis kyi sku rnams tsa ka li re re la bris pa hal tshon du byas pa nga rang gis legs par bris pa 'dra rje'i drung du gzigs phul bas/ 'di rnams rten 'brel shin tu legs/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gdan sa pa drug tsam na/ sa chen yab sras sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gdan sa pa lnga tsam 'byung ba'i ltas yin/ 'di rnams lam 'bras brgyud pa'i lder sku rnams kyi sku rgyab nar zhog cig gsungs nas der bzhag bla ma 'di rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa yin pa la the tshom med do/ /khyed rang rnams bla ma 'di'i sku'i bkod pa ji lta ba bzhin du spyi bo'i gtsug gam snying gi dkyil du sgoms shig bir srung re sgom pa dang mnyam par 'ong gsungs/ dgung lo nyer bdun pa stag gi lo la rje btsun mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug kun dga' bzang po pas mkhan po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis las kyi slob dpon/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gsang ste ston pa/ grub tshod nam mkha' dpal bzang pas grib rtsod mdzad nas dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa zhus te/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi phung pos mdzes par byas shing / bslab pa'i cha ches phra zhing phra ba dag la yang spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar 'tsho bar mdzad pas ltung ba che ba rnams lta ci smos/ tha na nyes byas kyi rigs chung ngu tsam gyis kyang gos pa med par mngon sum gyis grub pa yin no/ /de'i rgyu mtshan gyis gang du bzhugs pa'i sa'i phyogs mtha' dag kyang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong bar gyur pa dang / na bza' dang bzhugs gdan la sogs pa sku la reg pa rnams la yang phun sum tshogs pa'i dri bsung dang bcas pa 'byung ba dang /

zhal slob rnams kyi myong bas kyang grub ste/ bsnyen rdzogs mang po mdzad pa'i dus kyi las gral na yod pa kun la me tog 'gyed pa la phyag phebs byung ba'i dus su sngon tshor ma myong ba'i dri bzang po mi'i yul na longs spyod pa'i tsandan dang a ka ru la sogs pa dri bzang po gang gis kyang dpe bya bar mi nus pa zhig der yod kun gyis tshor ba 'byung ste/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i tshul khrims kyi dri bzang yin par nges shing / sngon bram ze mchog sred kyi slob ma nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba de btsun pa'i mchog tu gyur pa tshul khrims kyi dri gzhu 'dom lnga brgya tsam du tshor ba yod cing / chos skyong gi gsung gis/ khyod kyi tshul khrims 'di rnam par dag pas bdag skad cig kyang khyod dang mi 'bral bar bsrung ba dang dam tshig tu bgyis pa yin gsungs shing / gang bsgo ba de dag thogs pa med par 'grub pas bstan pa la phan du ma btags so shes grags la/ rje 'di nyid kyang de dag dang mtshungs pa'i rnam par thar pa mnga' ba zhig go zhes 'khums so/ /de ltar lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa 'dul ba'i sde snod nas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin nges par 'byung ba'i bsam pa can yon tan rin po che rnams kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pas thugs rgyud legs par btams so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ni/ snying rje chen po'i rtsa ba can yin pa las rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni dang po nyid nas 'gro ba mtha' dag la bu gcig pa ltar phan par brtson pa'i ngang tshul can yin pa dang / mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don la gzhol ba'i khur chen po 'degs par bzod cing / gzhan gyi log sgrub sna tshogs kyis 'khrugs par mi nus pa'i bzod pa'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i phyir sems dpa' chen po yin du zin kyang / slar yang gsal bar bya ba'i phyir dbu sems kyi shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po gnyis las byung ba'i cho ga'i lugs dang mthun par/

rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid las rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i tshul legs par nod cing thugs su tshud/ sa chen po la gnas pa'i 'phags pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa dang mthun par sku gsung thugs kyi kun tu spyod pa gang yang gzhan don du mi 'gyur ba skad cig tsam yang med par mdzad pa yin no/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa ni/ dbang bskur ba phyin ci ma log par thob cing / sdom pa 'og ma gnyis kyi rtsa ba can yin pa las/ rgyud sde las gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs par mnga' ba'i rigs thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid las dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa legs par nos te/ tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pa cung zad kyang mi bskyed pas/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi snang ba'i 'khor lor byin gyis brlabs nas lha dang ye shes kyi ngo bor kha dog bsgyur nas/ dag pa rab 'byams kyi snang ba 'ba' zhig gi dus 'da' bar mdzad pa yin pa la the tshom dang yid gnyis su gyur pa cung zad kyang med do/ /gnyis pa thos bsam sgom gsum spel mar mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ rje rdo rje 'chang dang mus chen sems pa chen po/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma rnams kyi drung du gsung ngag rin po che tshar bco lnga tsam gyis thog drangs pa'i rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dbang / rjes gnang / lung / man ngag rgya bod kyi gzhung mang po'i bshad pa sogs bgrang ba'i yul las 'das pa zhig gsan shing / gzhan yang 'dul ba dang / mngon pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu dag nos par mdzad de/ de ltar gsan pa rnams kyang tshig tsam ma yin par don dang bcas pa thugs su chud cing / chos kyi rnam grangs re re la yang brgyud pa'i khungs dang bcas pa phyin ci ma log par gsungs pa yin no/ /de dag gi skabs su rang nyid kyi gsung rab la gzigs rtog mdzad pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin par 'dug ste/

bod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gzigs rgya che che mor byed pa phal che ba zhig chos rje bu ston gyi yig cha rnams la bltas nas rang gis mthong ba skad zer ba mang / rdo rje 'chang gi gzigs rgya lta bu ni bod du ma byung ba'i tshod tsam yin/ nged kyis kyang bla ma'i phyag dpe gang yod tshar ba gcig dang / yang tshar phyed tsam lta rtog grub yod gsungs te/ bla brang na bzhugs pa'i phyag dpe'i grangs ni/ po sti bdun brgya lhag pa zhig dkar chag rnying pa la thebs snang ngo / /gzigs rtog mdzad pa rnams kyang re re nas thugs la gsal bar dran zhing / tha na lung gi khungs phra mo tsam la yang 'di 'di na yod bya ba la sogs dan rtags dang bcas te gsungs pa 'di ni shin tu ya mtshan pa zhig go /de ltar thos bsam du mdzad kyang ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun gcig las g.yo ba med par nyin mtshan khor yug tu zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyi dus 'da' ba 'di ni tha mal pa rnams kyis dpag par dka'o/ /spyi don gsum pa khyad par can gyi yon tan brnyes pa'i tshul la/ 'di'i rnam par thar pa rdzogs par bdag cag gi blo'i yul las 'das pa yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang gtso bor sgrub pa nyid la thugs gzhol bas rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa chen po thob pa yin par nges te/ chos rje glo bo mkhan chen pa drung na bzhugs pa'i skabs shig gsung las/ nga la ni rdo rje 'chang gi chos grwar dang po phyin pa tsam nas cir snang lha dang ye shes yin gsungs pa la nges pa brtan po byung zhes dngos su gsungs par grags pa las shes so/ /de nas bshad pa mdzad pa ni rang gi blo la shar tshod kyi tshig dang yi ge sna tshogs bshad pa las bla ma gong ma sangs rgyas dang 'dra ba rnams kyi gsung rab 'di rnams lag tu bzung ste bshad na tshig tsam la yang 'khrul pa mi 'byung zhing gting gi go don long pa la yang khyad par che bar 'dug gsungs nas/ rje btsun gong ma'i yig cha rnams kyi bshad pa rgyas la mtha' chod pa dang /

chos ji snyed cig gsungs pa rnams nges don gyi steng du 'bab cing gzhol ba'i tshul gyis ston par mdzad de/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i le'u las/ ji ltar thos pa'i chos rnams kyang zang zing med pa'i sems kyis thob pa dang bkur bsti dang tshigs su bcad pa la mi re bar gzhan dag la rgya cher yang dag par ston to/ /bdag gi tshig gi rjes su 'brangs par gzhan dag la chos mi ston to/ /ji ltar thos pa dang ji ltar gnas pa de bzhin du gzhan dag la chos ston to/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don dang legs par mthun pas na/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ rang gi bza' rgyu za zhing 'brel med kyi mi gzhan gyi dpe cha la 'chad nyan byed pa'i don med cing chos su 'gro ba dka'/ bya rgyu'i chos de chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas rgyal sras lam bzang las bshad pa lta bu'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa re dgos pa yin gsungs ba shin tu mad par snang ba yin no/ /des na gzhung dang don gyi cha gang la yang nyid kyis bshad pa'i tshul ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam par thar pa 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i phyir dang dus mtshungs pa'i mkhas pa'i skye bo mtha' dag gis zhabs kyi ze 'bru spyi bos len zhing / mngon par khengs pa'i mdud pa grol te dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston la spyod pas dam pa'i skye ba grangs las 'das pa zhig slob mo mdzad do/ /gzhung rtsom pa ni/ gzhan la phan pa nyid gtso bor mdzad kyi/ sdeb sbyor lhur mi mdzad mod/ 'on kyang mkhas pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog pa'i sdeb sbyor mdzad pa zhig ste/ lam dus kyi dbang gi cho ga yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / bla ma gong ma'i bstod pa dang / nyams mgur thor bur mdzad pa la sogs pa rnams la sdebs sbyor gyi tshul la mkhas pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog pa sha stag yod do/ /yang gzhan gyis brtsad cing dris pa na chos dang mthun par lan 'debs pa ni/ spobs pa thogs pa mi mnga' bar rigs pa dang lung gis pha rol gyi log par rtog pa sel bas/

rtog ge pa chen po sgra'i cha la ma rmongs pa dag kyang ba spu ldang ba zhig go /gzhan yang bla ma la gus pa ni rje bla ma yab sras nges par rdo rje 'chang yin pa la the tshom mam yid gnyis gtan mi mnga' ba yin par nges la/ de'i stobs kyi bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs thugs rgyud la zhugs te phyi nang gi yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu la dbang 'byor zhing / 'phrin las thams cad lhun gyis grub par 'byung ba yin no/ /de yang rje 'di nyid kyis chu mo lug gi lo nas shing pho sprel lo'i bar kye rdo rje yab yum gyi gzhi bsnyen kha gso'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa mdzad cing / gdan sa'i khur ma bzhes la de'i tshe yang yi dam lhas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ltas dang dag pa'i gzigs snang bsam las 'das pa byung bar 'dug kyang rgyas par ma smos so/ /shing mo bya'i lo sems dpa' chen po'i drung du phebs par rtsom pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen pos shing thog bil ba bzang po zhig phyag tu bsnams te/ bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur ldan pa'i chos/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang don kun 'grub gyur cig /ces pa'i shis brjod mdzad pa rmis gsungs/ de nas e wam̐ gyi gdan sar phebs phyin chad shis brjod dang mthun pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs ma lus pa mngon du gyur pa yin no/ /de la sogs pa thun mong ma yin pa'i tshul 'ga' zhig snang zhing rtog mod kyis brjod par mi spobs so/ /gzhan yang mnga' ris la lan snga ma phebs pa'i dus su rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi bshad pa dang / gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag legs par gnang ste/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po rnams dang / blo mchog tu gyur pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen grangs med pa rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyis smin par mdzad la/ skye bo'i tshogs thun mong ba rnams la byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa lan grangs du ma'i bar du gnang nas theg pa chen po'i lam du 'god par mdzad cing /

gzhan yang rab tu byung ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa stong phrag lhag tsam gyi mkhan po mdzad nas/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rgya mtshor spel lo/ /de'i skabs su bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rnams dang / bu slob rnams kyi 'bul ba'i dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba rnams kyang / bla ma gong ma zhal bzhugs pa rnam gnyis kyi drung du 'bul ba dang / gong ma rnams kyi dus mchod la sogs pa yul khyad par can kho na'i phyir du sbyar ba ma gtogs/ rang nyid kyis bdag tu 'dzin pa ni cung zad kyang mi mnga' ba yin no/ /mus kyi gling dgar sems dpa' chen po la mjal du byon pa'i tshe/ rje nyid kyi zhal ras gzigs pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin tshad med pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs te/ yun ring po'i bar du gnas de nyid du mnyam gzhag gi ngang la bzhugs so zhes kyang grag go /e wam̐ du phyag phebs nas kyang dbang dang / bshad pa dang / byin rlabs dang / lung dang / man ngag dang / khrid la sogs pa chos kyi sgo dpag tu med pa bstan pa'i sgo nas skal ldan gyi 'gro ba rab tu mang po tshim par mdzad de/ /gsung ngag yongs su rdzogs pa rang yang tshar bcu bdun tsam dang / tshul bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi bshad pa yang tshar nyi shu rtsa lnga lhag tsam zhig bshad do/ /zhes gsungs te de la sogs pa brjod kyis mi lang ngo / /slar yang mnga' ris kyi bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po rnams dang gdul bya rnams la dgongs te/ dpal ldan byams pa gling gi chos grwa chen por phebs nas bya lo'i son ngo de la mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing dang / bdag med ma'i bstod 'grel la bshad pa shin tu rgyas la mtha' chod pa zhig gsungs/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis gcig gsungs par bzhed kyang / zhu ba po'i stabs kyis ṭikka mu tig phreng ba'i steng nas bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi bshad pa gcig dang / rje btsun gyi ṭikka'i steng nas rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi rgyud kyi bshad pa dang /

lo hi pa'i rgya gzhung gi skor rnams zhib pa gcig gsungs so/ /de nas rje nyid kyi snyan pa dang grags pa'i dri bsung gis mnga' ris skor gsum gyi gdul bya'i tshogs padma'i mtsho la ngang pa 'du ba ltar tshogs pa dgu brgya lhag gcig 'dus pas/ gsung ngag rin po che'i gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa/ de dus bla ma nyid kyi gsung nas/ chos rje mus pa chen pos ngam ring du chos 'khor rjes ma la phebs dus gsung ngag gsan pa brgyad brgya tsam byung / de'i skabs su ngam ring chos sde'i mdun ngos kyi gzhung thams cad me tog ser po chung chung mang pos khengs 'dug pa rmis/ phyis phan pa'i rgyun ring po mi yong ba yin nam gsung gin 'dug de dus pas da lan sngags phyogs la sbyangs pa che ba mang zhing 'dun pa che ba'i sgo nas mnyan pa yang mang bar 'dug pas bstan pa'i rgyun la phan stobs da lan ngos che ba yong ba 'dra gsungs shing thugs spro ba mdzad kyin snang / de nas zla ba bcu pa la gsung ngag tshugs te sa ga zla ba'i bar la gdams ngag gi chos skor zhib cing rgyas la mtha' chod par gsungs shing / skal ldan gyi gdul bya grangs med pa rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyis smin cing grol bar mdzad la/ gzhan yang skye bo'i tshogs stong phrag lhag tsam gcig la byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa mdzad cing / dge slong dang dge tshul la sogs pa rab tu mang ba yang stong phrag tu longs pa bsgrubs te/ sdom pa gsum ga'i nyams len la skal ldan gyi slob ma rnams dus gcig la 'god pa ni/ rje 'di nyid las lhag pa ma byung ngo snyam du soms so/ /de ltar chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po skor ba'i skabs su yang sa chen po g.yos shing phyogs kun tu sgra grags pa dang / dri bzang pos thams cad du khyab pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma kun gyi mngon sum du byung ngo / /gnyis pa chos kyi sku'i mdzad pa ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul ni/

rje btsun bla ma'i thugs kyi sras rgyal tshab dam pa'i gsung las 'byung ba bzhin brjod par bya ste/ chos rje rin po che 'di nyid gdul bya'i ngor tshul bzung ba tsam ma gtogs/ skye ba dang 'jig pa sogs la dbang 'byor pa ste/ rang gis ma nges pa ma gtogs/ phyis bka' lung sogs legs par bsams na/ gzhan don la gshegs pa yang snga mo nas dgongs par gda' bas gsung chos gnang ba sogs kyang thugs rtsol shin tu che zhing / chos tshogs chen po'ang 'phro med du gnang ba dang / gsung ngag 'dzugs gong du/ lam 'bras 'di myur du 'dzugs/ nga'i pha yang lo 'di la shi ba yin/ lam 'bras sgang la dpon slob su la'ang bar chad med pa dga' bas/ de la dmigs pa'i smon lam gcig byed gsungs pa'i bka' lung thol byung gcig gnang ba dang / rgyu dus dbang bskur yang nyin re la sta gon/ dngos gzhi yongs su rdzogs pa tshar gnyis re gnang zhing / de'i mtshams su yang gsung chos phran tshegs gnang ba sogs dus thog tu ma grub dogs pa lta bu mdzad/ zur nas nam zla grang ba dang / mi tshogs ches pa 'di la gsung chos gnang phul ches pas sku khams la gnod pa lta bu e srid dogs pas/ de bzhin gyi zhu ba phul kyang snga ma nyid thugs yul du mdzad de zhu ba ma tshugs shing / tshogs pa yang mang bar 'dug chos don du gnyer ba mang pas don gnyer 'ga' zhig gi ma thob nyen yod gsungs/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi srung ba/ mgon po lcam dral dang lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang sogs ni mi gsum mam/ lnga 'am/ bdun las mang ba la mdzad pa'i srol med/ thun mong ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i mgon po'i rjes gnang rnams tshogs su kun gyis thob pa ma byas na/ ma zin pa'i nyen yod gsungs nas gnang ba dang / gzhan bla ma nyid do dam du bskos pa'i tshul gyis bskul lcag yang yang du mdzad nas grub par mdzad pa dang / byams gling spyi pas sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig nas/

nyer drug gi bar sgrub mchod rgyun ma zhig yod pa la/ khong rnams kyis sgrub mchod rgyun ma 'di sngar nas ni sa ga zla ba kho na la byed/ da lo sde pa'i dus rtsis pa rnams kyis zla bshol bton nas sa ga zla ba phyi ma la byed par 'dug pas/ de ltar na gsung chos tshugs pa dang thug pa 'dra/ da lta chos mtshams 'di la bsgrubs na e yongs zhus pas/ spyir bla ma'i dus mchod bshol 'don pa sogs mi mdzad/ sa ga zla ba 'di ka yin/ dpon pos zla bshol 'don pa 'dug na'ang / nged kyang sa ga 'di la byed/ khyed rang yang sgrub mchod tshugs la nam nus kyi bar du byas pas chog gsungs pa sogs mkhyen cing dgongs pa'i zhal lta mang du gnang / zla ba de'i tshes bcu gnyis nas bco lnga'i bar du sku mtshams se ba gcig mdzad/ bcu drug nas brtsams te bcu dgu'i bar du lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs sogs gdams ngag shin du zab pa 'ga' zhig cig snod ldan nyung bsdus gcig la shin tu rgyas shing mtha' chod pa nan chags dang bcas te gnang / gzhan yang zhal gyis bzhes pa'i gsung chos tshogs chung ba 'dra dang / sngar gyi chos 'phro'i gdams ngag lung sogs phal cher yongs su rdzogs par mdzad/ de bar sku la bsnyung gzhi'am ngal dub la sogs pa mngon du gyur pa ni cung zad kyang med/ tshes nyi shu la sku khams cung zad ltems pa gcig byung / snga gong na mgur sman zhu ba la sogs pa 'tsho byed rgyun ma gcig yod pa na re/ ser ma cung zad shas che bar 'dug gzhan ni yid mi bde ba'i phyag rtsa la sogs pa gang yang med/ ser ma 'di la phan pa'i gsol sman gcig 'bul zer ba la/ rje nyid spyir gsol sman bzhes pa la phul shin tu che ba zhig yin na yang / sman ye mi dgos/ phan pa med pa'i sman sbyar kyang / sbyor ba tshegs che zhing sbyar ba don med du 'gro bas mi dgos gsungs/ sku la g.yel ba cher mi mnga' ba'i stobs kyis/

drung na yod pa rnams la yang yid mi bde ba sogs med pa/ gsol ja'i bar du chos kyi 'gro ba phan tshun du gleng ba dang / rje'i drung du dogs gcod zhu ba sogs rgyun ldan du mdzad/ gsol ja grol rjes sku khams je ltems song ba zhig byung / de ring kha sing gi chos 'phro de byed rgyu yod pas/ gung tshigs grol 'phral chos nyan rnams sdus gsungs na yang / mi gnang kha med du mi 'dug snga nyin gyi lam zab kyi 'phro cung zad yin pas bzod dam snyam/ de ring sku khams ltems par 'dug pas de ring tsam 'then pa zhig zab pa 'dra/ khong rnams kyang de'i lugs shig byas yod lags zhus pas/ khong rnams chos ma thob dogs pa ma gtogs mi 'dod pa med/ khyod kyis khong rnams kyi chos 'phro bcad gsungs/ thugs kyis mi bzod pa'i rnam pa chen po mdzad/ cung zad nas de ring lus shed chung bar 'dug pas 'then pa de ngos yin tshod 'dug gsungs/ phyil red kyi dus su sku shed je chung che chung gi rnam pa byung / de ring dgong mo ja mgron sogs su yang mi 'bod/ gtor bsngo snga ba zhig byed pas gtor ma rnams da lta rdzis/ gtor bsngo yang da lta byed pa yin gsungs/ rgyun ma las snga bar mdzad/ thugs dam rgyun ma la yang snga dus las thugs rtsol che zhing / drung nar mi bzhin 'gro ba la thugs kyis mi bzod pa thugs so mi sod pa'i rnam pa chen po mdzad/ thugs dam grol nas gzim mal bzhugs gdan la phebs rjes/ thol byung gi zhal lta kha yar gnang / de nas cung zhig nas/ nga 'bod pa de mi 'khrugs pa yin pa 'dug gam gsungs/ lan zhu ma phod pa la go zhes gsungs/ 'di yan chad du de tsam ma gtogs gzhan dag snang gi bka' lung cher ma byung / de nas blos ma bzod pa'i tshul gyis sku drung na mi kha yar yod pa la/ thugs la mi ldan pa dang / thugs so mi sod pa'i rnam pa chen po mdzad/ thams cad tha dad du byon ces yang yang gsungs/

gzhan rnams kyis phyi na g.yab gcig yod par cung zad bsdad/ drung na chos rje mkhan chen pa gcig pu bzhugs yod pa'i tshe/ sku'i nyams dang / rnam 'gyur shin tu che zhing mang ba zhig mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ ci 'dra zhig yong ngam snyam/ bzhugs gdan 'di zhal shar la gzigs pa zhig byas na legs pa 'dra zhus pas/ de ltar byas na mi yong / nub phyogs su blta dgos/ bla ma dam pa rnams bde ba can na bzhugs yod/ der sleb tu re gsungs pa 'dra ba gcig byung yang / nga rang gsol ba thebs pa gcig mi yong ba yin nam snyam/ cung zad rtab pa'i rnam par song nas bka' lung gsal nges gcig ma byung pas/ bde ba can la yin lags sam zhus pas/ spro ba dang bcas te 'o 'o zhes gsungs/ de nas brtsams te zhal bde ba can la gzigs pa'i bzhugs gdan la bzhugs/ de tsam na tha mal gyi rnam rtog rnams shas cher nub/ dag snang 'ba' zhig la bzhugs/ glo bur du sku la 'ju ba'am snyan du zhu ba sogs byas na/ lan tshig re tshig gnyis ma gtogs/ tha mal gyi bka' lung tshig gcig kyang mi 'byung zhing / mtshan gung tsam la thugs rgyud la bde ba chen po 'khrungs pa'i rnam pas/ dga' ba/ bde ba/ mi 'gyur ba/ dri ma med pa zhes rgyun mi 'chad par yang dang yang du gsungs te/ phyag gi rnam 'gyur shin tu mang ba mdzad/ cung zad re nas sangs rgyas 'gyur ba med pa bde ba chen po sangs rgyas kyi ye shes zhes mtshan gyi rnam grangs 'brel chags par gsungs/ tho rangs kyi dus na lho phyogs kyi nam mkha' la hed de gzigs te/ cung zad nas rdo rje'i pho brang dang / he ru ka yang 'dug gsungs/ gzhan yang ḍā ki ni/ ḍā ki ni zhes sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pas/ gzigs snang yang bsam las 'das pa zhig byung ba 'dra/ 'di yan chad du sku lus kyang gang bde/ phyag gi rnam 'gyur/ gsung gi smra brjod du ma mdzad kyang / nyer gcig gi nyi rtse tsam nas zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung /

phyag mnyam gzhag mdzad/ gsung gi smra brjod sogs kyang spangs te ting nge 'dzin rtse gcig la bzhugs/ srod kyi dus su bzhugs sar gsol ba ma thebs dogs/ rgyu mtshan cung zad zhus pas/ gzhan ni cher ma byung / e 'chi yang mi shes/ shi na yang sems la 'khri ba dang zhen pa rdul tsam yang med/ 'pho ba 'dra byed/ smon lam rnam par dag pa 'dra 'debs pa yin mod gsungs pa ltar/ tsha ba thon rjes la 'da' kha ma'i man ngag dang / smon lam rnam par dag pa'i ngang nas bde ba can du gshegs par gdon mi za/ de'i tshe lha'i me tog dang / dri dang rol mo'i tshogs rnams ni/ skye bo tha mal pa rnams kyis kyang mngon du gyur/ snga gong gzhan don la gshegs pa'i ltas su yang / sa g.yo ba dang / sgra grag pa dang / bya sna tshogs rang skad spangs te sna tshogs pa'i skad gzhan bsgyur ba/ gang zag gzhan gyi rmi ltas ngo mtshar ba sna tshogs byung pa rnams ni kun gyi mngon du gyur par grags la ya mtshan pa'i mtshan gzhir byed cing / sku gdung bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang la mi ma yin gyi 'gro bas bskor ba byed pa 'ba' zhig gi mngon du gyur ces kyang zer/ sku gdung bzhugs pa'i mchod khang la ni pu tra sogs dkon gnyer gyi tshul du 'bral med du gnas pa'i mtshan ma thob par yang bshad la/ sku gdung bzhu ba'i tshe 'ja' 'od dang / dri bzang pos phyogs kun tu khyab pa dang / gdung khang zhal phye ste dbu thod ril por byon pa la sna tshogs pa'i ri mos mdzes par byas pa dang / kha dog sna tshogs pa'i ring bsrel bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa ni/ phyis kyi gdul bya rnams chos brgyud dang grub mtha' la nges pa bskyed pa dang / sku dngos kyi gdul bya rnams bsod nams rnam par spel ba'i phyir du ngo mtshar ba'i ltas rnams bstan cing bskyed par gda'/ gzhan yang brjod par mi lang ba'i rnam par thar pa phal mo che ni dngos kyi gdul bya rnams kyi snyan na bzhugs shing thugs la yang gsal lo/

/spyi don gsum pa 'phrin las kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad pa'i tshul ni/ sa'i phyogs tha dad rnams su yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po rnams kyis gtso mdzad/ bu slob dad pa can rnams kyis rgyud sde zab mo rnams las gsungs pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor rab tu mang po bzhengs nas bsgrubs shing mchod pa'i rgyun dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa khri phrag tu longs pa la bsnyen cing bkur ba dang 'bul 'gyed kyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgrubs shing / sku'i rten lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa tshang ba dang / 'bul 'gyed kyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgrubs shing / gsung gi rten sa skya bka' 'bum dang / thugs kyi rten byang chub chen po'i mchod rten la sogs pa bar chad med pa grub pa yin la/ sku gdung byin po e wam̐ gyi dgon par phebs nas kyang / nang rten sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi sku rgyab mtho bcu gsum pa yod pa gandho la dang bcas pa gcig rje de nyid kyi gzim mal sku 'dra sku tshad ma gcig lam zab brgyud pa'i kha skong sku 'dra 'khyil gang pa gcig de rnams kyi phud la rdo rje 'chang gi sku 'khyil gang pa gcig phyi rten rje gong ma rnams kyi phyi rten dang tshad mnyam pa gcig rnams yongs su rdzogs par grub pa la 'bad pa med cing nyer 'tshe'i rnam pa cung zad kyang med pa ni rje nyid kyi thugs rje yin la/ slar yang rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi byin gyis brlabs pa mkhas shing grub pa thob pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis gdan sa yun ring du bskyangs nas 'khor ba ji srid par 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa yang / rje btsun mchog 'di'i 'phrin las las byung ba'o/ /de ltar nyams rtogs mthar phyin chos kyi rje/ /kun dga' dbang phyug rnam thar 'di bkod pas/ /bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi dus gsum du/ /bsags pa'i sdig sgrib ma lus byang gyur cig

/rdo rje 'chang chen yab sras bstan pa'i rgyun/ /rgyal tshab dam pas bskyangs shing 'phel ba ltar/ /bdag la bstan 'dzin chos dang rigs kyi bu/ /yid la re ba'i bsam pa de 'byung shog /dus 'dir bdag dang gdul byar bcas pa rnams/ /tshe ring nad med bstan pa rgyas byed cing / /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /sprul pas bstan pa srid mthar rgyas byed shog /ces chos kyi rje rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug gi rnam par thar pa mdo tsam bshad pa 'di yang / dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang lo zhe gcig lon pa glang gi lo dpal sa skyar gsung ngag tshar bdun pa bshad dus rgyal tshab chos rje'i rnam thar glo bo mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams lhun grub kyis mdzad pa nas nyung ngur bsdus te sbyar ba 'dis bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig yi ge pa ni rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i shab stod pa bkra shis don grub kyis bgyis so// //sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 a myes zhabs/ chos kyi rje rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug gi rnam thar/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 11
